subject.title: [Feature]: Hold one sandbox lease across compound filesystem operations

question: Should operation-scoped filesystem leasing remain a focused follow-up after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103553 lands, or be incorporated into that open lifecycle change?
rationale: The choice sets the review boundary for a sandbox availability primitive that can defer automatic replacement, while its prerequisite coordinator is still under review.

options.title: Focused follow-up
options.body: Finalize the coordinator first, then add operation scope with isolated copy, fairness, abort, error, and real Docker proof.

options.title: Fold into prerequisite
options.body: Expand the open lifecycle PR to include operation scope and review the combined availability boundary together.

options.title: Retain command scope
options.body: Accept that compound filesystem requests may span container generations and document that limitation explicitly.

recommendation.title: Focused follow-up
recommendation.body: Finalize the coordinator first, then add operation scope with isolated copy, fairness, abort, error, and real Docker proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current compound-copy path, authored the prerequisite lifecycle proposal, and identified this exact remaining boundary.
